title: Vertical line-screen type

reference.grammar: one-ink print: heavy slab type, tight leading, screened as vertical bars at a fixed pitch; bars merge where lines of type overlap; small caps captions in the corners, spaced word row at the foot

techniques.name: Vertical line screen

params.end_cells: bar ends snap to 0.5-pitch cells down the page
params.mask: sum of four text lines, Archivo 900 condensed, blurred 1.2 px

techniques.implementation: For every screen column x_k = k·pitch, walk down the page one device pixel at a time, read the summed letter mask at (x_k + phase, y), map it to a bar width and fill each continuous run as one polygon with a left and a right edge per y.

techniques.name: Phase field
techniques.implementation: phase(x,y) = 2.4·fbm(x/260, y/260) plus half a pitch in regions where the field is high; the bar center is x_k + phase, so bars in neighbouring regions step against each other.

techniques.name: Ink bleed

params.interior_darken: ink → ink_deep (#3E3A38) where mask > 0.9, ramp from 0.6

techniques.implementation: The bar layer is blurred 0.8 px, its alpha is pushed through a soft threshold so the edge swells outward, and the ink color shifts toward ink_deep inside the letters.

techniques.name: Paper tooth
techniques.implementation: Luminance is multiplied by 1 + mottle before the bars land and by ART.grain after, so ink and paper share one tooth.

techniques.name: Caption blocks

params.corner_blocks: Archivo 800 condensed caps, 18 u, line 20 u, at (83,55) and (698,55)
params.word_row: JetBrains Mono 700 14 u, seven words justified from 83 u to 922 u at 598 u

techniques.implementation: Plain fills in the caption color; the word row divides the leftover width equally between the words.

pass_order: mask · four text lines summed into a luminance layer, blurred 1.2 px
bars · one polygon per continuous run per column
bleed · 0.7 px blur, soft threshold, interior darkening
captions · corner blocks, credit, word row
notes: Measured on ref.png: pitch 10 px at 1448 px (6.9 u); bar runs 6–7 px inside letters (0.68 pitch), 11 px+ where lines merge; paper (229,226,220) covers 80 %; ink (65,62,59) 15 %; paper std 4.4 / 255.
The reference type is a slab serif; no serif is inlined, so the rebuild sets Archivo 900 at condensed width (font-stretch 75 %), which keeps the stroke weight and the tight leading but not the slabs.
